title: Fusion Suite
identity: Catherine McMichael, Fusion Suite (2006), for baritone saxophone and piano, approximately 12 minutes. C. Alan lists three movements and dedication to Lynn Klock; Albany Records identifies Klock and the composer on a 2010 album of world-premiere recordings written for Klock or his students.

evidence.claim: Publisher identifies baritone saxophone and piano, medium level, 12:15 duration, three movement program and dedication to Lynn Klock.
Composer page confirms three movements and describes their evening setting.
Albany Records identifies the world-premiere recording with Lynn Klock, baritone saxophone, and Catherine McMichael, piano.

C. Alan Publications search result lists Fusion Suite for baritone saxophone and piano, medium, 12:15, dedicated to saxophone professor Lynn Klock, and describes three movements inspired by jazz-rock fusion. Official page itself returned cache miss.

Albany Records TROY1182, opened, identifies Fusion Suite performed by Lynn Klock, baritone saxophone, and Catherine McMichael, piano, as a track on a 2010 album of world-premiere recordings for Klock or his students.

review_focus: Inference: publisher description distinguishes an energetic, syncopated opening movement from two more lyrical movements. This gives a useful contrast to check against the score; notation itself was not inspected.
collection_flag: Original baritone saxophone/piano work dedicated to Lynn Klock and documented as a world-premiere professional recording.

listening.description: Albany Records track credited to Lynn Klock, baritone saxophone, and Catherine McMichael, piano.
listening.verification: Album track and performers listed on opened label page; playback not auditioned.
